{"action":"call_tool","name":"write_file","arguments_json":"{\"relative_path\":\"split.mjs\",\"content\":\"export function allocateShares(totalCents, people) {\\n  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(totalCents) || totalCents < 0) throw new Error('invalid total');\\n  if (!Number.isInteger(people) || people < 1 || people > 1000) throw new Error('invalid people');\\n\\n  const each = Math.floor(totalCents / people);\\n  const remainder = totalCents % people;\\n  return Array.from({ length: people }, (_, index) => each + (index < remainder ? 1 : 0));\\n}\\n\"}","text":null}

{"action":"call_tool","name":"write_file","arguments_json":"{\"relative_path\":\"split.test.mjs\",\"content\":\"import test from 'node:test';\\nimport assert from 'node:assert/strict';\\nimport { allocateShares } from './split.mjs';\\n\\ntest('distributes every cent exactly once, with remainder cents assigned first', () => {\\n  const shares = allocateShares(1001, 3);\\n  assert.deepEqual(shares, [334, 334, 333]);\\n  assert.equal(shares.reduce((sum, share) => sum + share, 0), 1001);\\n});\\n\\ntest('supports an even split and the people limit', () => {\\n  assert.deepEqual(allocateShares(1200, 4), [300, 300, 300, 300]);\\n  assert.equal(allocateShares(1000, 1000).reduce((sum, share) => sum + share, 0), 1000);\\n});\\n\\ntest('rejects invalid totals and party sizes', () => {\\n  for (const total of [0, -1, 1.5, NaN]) assert.throws(() => allocateShares(total, 2));\\n  for (const people of [0, -1, 1.5, 1001, NaN]) assert.throws(() => allocateShares(100, people));\\n});\\n\"}","text":null}
